mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO v5ai_conversation_summary (conversation_id, summary, covered_until_message_id, covered_messages, model_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{summary}, #{coveredUntilMessageId}, #{coveredMessages}, #{modelId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE summary = IF(VALUES(covered_until_message_id) > covered_until_message_id, VALUES(summary), summary), covered_messages = IF(VALUES(covered_until_message_id) > covered_until_message_id, VALUES(covered_messages), covered_messages), model_id = IF(VALUES(covered_until_message_id) > covered_until_message_id, VALUES(model_id), model_id), updated_at = IF(VALUES(covered_until_message_id) > covered_until_message_id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at), covered_until_message_id = IF(VALUES(covered_until_message_id) > covered_until_message_id, VALUES(covered_until_message_id), covered_until_message_id)
ON CONFLICT (conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET summary = EXCLUDED.summary, covered_until_message_id = EXCLUDED.covered_until_message_id, covered_messages = EXCLUDED.covered_messages, model_id = EXCLUDED.model_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE v5ai_conversation_summary.covered_until_message_id < EXCLUDED.covered_until_message_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM v5ai_conversation_summary WHERE conversation_id IN (SELECT id FROM v5ai_conversation WHERE agent_key = #{agentKey})
